Name: (CP) Yuzu Trees
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds a new fruit tree, Yuzu, to the game.[/b][/size]
[size=4]Thats it. no really, this ones nice and simple! 

It even has a nice little plant pot that you can config on and off, if you want it. 

This is also compatible with Cornucopia! It has a config to allow you to replace the cornucopia yuzu tree with this one. If yes, the Cornucopia yuzu will simply act like mine, If No, you can have both types of yuzu tree at the same time. 

As a small easter egg, if you gift Yuzu to Yuzuki from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43006?tab=posts&BH=2]Vaels Familiars[/url], She'll react happily, as it is her favorite fruit. [/size]
